meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides YouTube Music promo banners, the Premium upsell pop-up, and optionally the Upgrade tab
meta.notes:
**Live check (2026-11-13).** Checked `https://music.youtube.com/` in logged-out desktop Chromium at 1512×862. The page showed the public home feed and sign-in prompt; none of the four `ytmusic-*` / `SPunlimited` selectors or the common cookie selectors matched. The promo/dialog rules remain unverified because they may require a signed-in or triggered state. `recipes/fixtures/youtube-music/` contains synthetic contract fixtures, not site captures.

The recipe covers `music.youtube.com` only. The separate YouTube recipe covers `www.youtube.com` and `m.youtube.com`.

- **Promo banners** and the **Premium upsell** are on by default.
- **Upgrade tab** is off by default: it is a navigation entry you may want.
- Ads inside playback are not touched: CSS cannot remove them.
